analyzed: paṇyakṛtaḥ vātsalyadhīra ākhya bhaktasya tad patnyāḥ ca mañjulikāyāḥ atibhaktyā prasannaḥ prabhuḥ darśanam dadau sādhūbhūtau tau tu vartete ityādi

original: 206. tilakaraṃgākhyasya vanapālasya śivabhaktasya sādhurūpaśivoktabhaktyā nārāyaṇopāsanayā paramamuktirityādi ।
analyzed: tilakaraṃga ākhyasya vanapālasya śiva bhaktasya sādhu rūpa śiva ukta bhaktyā nārāyaṇa upāsanayā parama muktiḥ ityādi

original: 207. kṣetrapasya nāñjabhaktasya mahāmayabhaktasya karṣukāṇāṃ ca rakṣaṇaṃ bhagavatā luṇṭakebhyaḥ kṛtamityādi ।
analyzed: kṣetrapasya nāñja bhaktasya mahāmaya bhaktasya karṣukāṇām ca rakṣaṇam bhagavatā luṇṭakebhyaḥ kṛtam ityādi

original: 208. sāgarākhyakirātasya bhaktasya bhaktyā prasannena śrīhariṇā śreṣṭhirūpeṇa godhūmapuñjo'rpitaḥ kusulastho'kṣayaśca kṛtaḥ, tatpolikābhājājalapātrāṇyakṣayāṇi kṛtāni mokṣaśca kṛta ityādi ।
analyzed: sāgara ākhya kirātasya bhaktasya bhaktyā prasannena śrī hariṇā śreṣṭhi rūpeṇa godhūma puñja ūrpitaḥ kusula sthaḥ kṣayaḥ ca kṛtaḥ kṛtāni mokṣaḥ ca kṛtaḥ ityādi

original: 209. sāraṃganāmakasya hūṇabhaktasya mahiṣīpaśudhanasyā'raṇye siṃhakṛtāpadaḥ śrīhariṇā rakṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ mokṣaścetyādi ।
analyzed: sāraṃga nāmakasya hūṇa bhaktasya mahiṣī paśu dhanasya araṇye siṃha kṛta āpadaḥ śrī hariṇā rakṣaṇam kṛtam mokṣaḥ ca ityādi

original: 210. yajñarādhanāmakapuṣkasasya sakuṭumbasya brahmāyanarṣisādhoḥ samāgamena śrīharibhaktyā mokṣaprāptirityādi ।
analyzed: yajñarādha nāmaka puṣkasasya sa kuṭumbasya brahmāyana ṛṣi sādhoḥ samāgamena śrī hari bhaktyā mokṣa prāptiḥ ityādi

original: 211. kapikṣayākhyasya cāṇḍālasya vānararūpadevopadeśena śrīharau bhaktyā sakuṭumbasya mokṣaṇamityādi ।
analyzed: kapi kṣaya ākhyasya cāṇḍālasya vānara rūpa deva upadeśena śrī harau bhaktyā sa kuṭumbasya mokṣaṇam ityādi

original: 212. nālīkarasya lohakārasya bhaktyā śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇagaruḍadattadarśanaṃ bhaktasya mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādi ।
analyzed: nālīkarasya lohakārasya bhaktyā śrī lakṣmī nārāyaṇa garuḍa datta darśanam bhaktasya mokṣaṇam ca ityādi

original: 213. maṃgaladevākhyacarmakārabhaktasya bhaktyā sākṣādbhagavatā samāgatya viṣavāraṇaṃ kṛtamityādi ।
analyzed: maṃgaladeva ākhya carmakāra bhaktasya bhaktyā sākṣāt bhagavatā samāgatya viṣa vāraṇam kṛtam ityādi

original: 214. haridāsākhyasya rathakārasya bhaktyā sakuṭumbasya bhagavatā mokṣaḥ kṛtaityādi ।
analyzed: haridāsa ākhyasya rathakārasya bhaktyā sa kuṭumbasya bhagavatā mokṣaḥ kṛtā ityādi

original: 215. śilāhārasya dāmaśilādanāmakabhaktasya bhṛtyānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dāmaśilādādeścānte mokṣaṇaṃ ca bhagavatā kṛtamityādi ।
analyzed: śilā āhārasya dāmaśilāda nāmaka bhaktasya bhṛtyānām rakṣaṇam dāmaśilāda ādeḥ ca ante mokṣaṇam ca bhagavatā kṛtam ityādi

original: 216. śilpakārasya sañjayadevasya bhaktyā bhagavatā gajato rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtamityādi ।
analyzed: śilpakārasya sañjayadevasya bhaktyā bhagavatā gajataḥ rakṣaṇam mokṣaṇam ca kṛtam ityādi

original: 217. saṃbharadevākhyacitrakārasya bhaktyā bhagavatā dattaṃ darśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtamityādi ।
analyzed: saṃbharadeva ākhya citra kārasya bhaktyā bhagavatā dattam darśanam mokṣaṇam ca kṛtam ityādi

original: 218 mauktikeśināmno bhaktasya śilāṃgārakhanisvāmino bhaktyā bhagavatā mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādi ।
analyzed: mauktikeśi nāmnaḥ bhaktasya śilāṃgāra khani svāminaḥ bhaktyā bhagavatā mokṣaṇam kṛtam ityādi

original: 219 lubdhakasya cakradharākhyasya pautimāṣyarṣisaṃgamena hiṃsādipāpanāśe bhaktyuttaraṃ muktirityādi ।
analyzed: lubdhakasya cakradhara ākhyasya pauti māṣya ṛṣi saṃgamena hiṃsā ādi pāpa nāśe bhakti uttaram muktiḥ ityādi

original: 220 vāṭadharasya piśunakhavāsasya bhaktasya tathā dvaipī- rājñyāśca sutārasiṃhanṛpaterdaṇḍād bhagavatā rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtamityādi ।
analyzed: vāṭa dharasya piśunakha vāsasya bhaktasya tathā dvaipī rājñyāḥ ca sutāra siṃha nṛpateḥ daṇḍāt bhagavatā rakṣaṇam mokṣaṇam ca kṛtam ityādi
vṛṣaparva nāma ṛṣi yogena prāsāda kārasya śivajayasya mokṣaṇam ityādi

original: 222. saṃgarayādaskabhaktasya jālakāryaṃ tyājayitvā śuklāyanasādhunā bhagavatprāptiḥ kāritetyādi ।
analyzed: saṃgara yādaska bhaktasya jāla kāryam tyājayitvā śuklāyana sādhunā bhagavat prāptiḥ kāritā ityādi
udyama śrī prabhṛti bhara vāṭānām satī īśvarī sādhvī sat saṃgena kṛṣṇe bhaktiḥ mokṣaṇam ca ityādi
rāmāyana ākhya sādhu yogena dīrgha rava ādīnām uṣṭra pālānām mokṣaṇam ityādi
ratnaprabha ākhya bhaktasya rāsabha pālasya narasiṃha svāmi yogena mokṣaṇa ādi

original: 226. gadārdaneśvaranāmakavaidyasya pāpairduḥkhāni tatpatnyā mukundinyā bhaktyā tu mokṣaṇamityādi ।
analyzed: gadārdana īśvara nāmaka vaidyasya pāpaiḥ duḥkhāni tad patnyā mukundinyā bhaktyā tu mokṣaṇam ityādi
deśyā vanasya kīśapālasya sudhā amara sādhoḥ prasaṃgena mokṣaṇam ityādi

original: 228. svarṇadhanvanṛpaterbhṛtyasya harṣadharmanāpitasya patnyā nigamikāyā bhaktyā kalyāṇadhāmādisādhusevāyāṃ sthitāyāḥ sevayā ca prasanno bhagavān nigamikā- rūpadharo bhūtvā rājñīsevāmakarot, nāpitakuṭumbasya rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cākarodityādi ।
analyzed: svarṇadhanva nṛpateḥ bhṛtyasya harṣadharma nāpitasya patnyāḥ nigamikāyāḥ bhaktyā kalyāṇadhāma ādi sādhu sevāyām sthitāyāḥ sevayā ca prasannaḥ bhagavān nigamikā rūpa dharaḥ bhūtvā rājñī sevām akarot nāpita kuṭumbasya rakṣaṇam mokṣaṇam ca akarot ityādi

original: 229 pūrvajanmani dhīvaryā ruṭāṇakyā ābhīrībhaktāyāḥ sādhvīnāṃ ca daityād rakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādi ।
analyzed: pūrva janmani dhīvaryāḥ ruṭāṇakyāḥ ābhīrī bhaktāyāḥ sādhvīnām ca daityāt rakṣaṇam mokṣaṇam ca ityādi

original: 230. pūrvajanmani matsyamārāṇāṃ dhīraparvādīnāṃ yāmyayā- tanottaraṃ pūrvapuṇyena naupatijanmāni tatra bhajanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādi ।
analyzed: pūrva janmani matsya mārāṇām dhīraparva ādīnām yāmyayā tanā uttaram pūrva puṇyena naupati janmāni tatra bhajanam mokṣaṇam ca ityādi

original: 231. śūlīpradasya tārakādarśasya tatpatnyāśca kṛta- śalyāyā bhaktyā'bhyudayo mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādi ।
analyzed: śūlī pradasya tārakādarśasya tad patnyāḥ ca bhaktyā abhyudayaḥ mokṣaṇam ca ityādi

original: 232. jvālāprasādākhyasyāṃ'gārāgnikṛto bhagavadbhaktyā nārāyaṇāyanasādhuyogena tasya tatpatnyāḥ sahasrādi- dehināṃ ca bhagavatā mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityādi ।
analyzed: jvālā prasāda ākhyasya aṃgāra agni kṛtaḥ bhagavat bhaktyā nārāyaṇāyana sādhu yogena tasya tad patnyāḥ sahasra ādi dehinām ca bhagavatā mokṣaṇam kṛtam ityādi

original: 233. lavādanākhyapradhānasya rājñe garadasya bhagavadbhaktyā kiṃśukāyanasādhusevayā ca tasya tadrājñīnāṃ ca prajānāṃ ca mokṣaṇamityādi ।
analyzed: lavādana ākhya pradhānasya rājñe garadasya bhagavat bhaktyā kiṃśukāyana sādhu sevayā ca tasya tad rājñīnām ca prajānām ca mokṣaṇam ityādi

original: 234. nirmohanāyanasādhuprasaṃgena vikhaṇḍalākhyaśastra- dharasya tatpatnyā harasatyāśca bhagavaddarśanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādi ।
analyzed: nirmohanāyana sādhu prasaṃgena vikhaṇḍala ākhya śastra dharasya tad patnyāḥ harasatyāḥ ca bhagavat darśanam mokṣaṇam ca ityādi

original: 235. jīrṇodbhavanāmakakṛṣīvalasya caitanyakāyanisādhu- yogena mokṣaṇaṃ strīsaundaryādipradavratadānavarṇanaṃ cetyādi ।
analyzed: jīrṇodbhava nāmaka kṛṣīvalasya yogena mokṣaṇam strī saundarya ādi prada vrata dāna varṇanam ca ityādi

original: 237. dvāparasantānasya kathāviṣayasaṃkṣepo dvāparasantāna- viśeṣamāhāpmyaṃ caturyugasantānānāṃ pratyakṣāgamaḥ kalermokṣārhatvaprārthanā tiṣyasantānaprastāva āśīrvādaścetyādi ।
analyzed: dvāpara santānasya kathā viṣaya saṃkṣepaḥ dvāpara santāna viśeṣa māhāpmyam caturyuga santānānām pratyakṣa āgamaḥ kaleḥ mokṣa arha tva prārthanā tiṣya santāna prastāvaḥ āśīrvādaḥ ca ityādi
iti śrī lakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāḥ dvāpara santāna ātmaka tṛtīya khaṇḍasya adhyāya anukramaṇikā
